cases.prompt: Review this Go PR that adds a transaction, emits an event, and retries the downstream request.
cases.reason: The diff crosses persistence, messaging, and remote-failure boundaries.

cases.prompt: Review a Go change that adds background workers and a new shutdown path. Report only actionable findings.
cases.reason: The task requests risk-driven review of production concurrency behavior.

cases.prompt: Check whether this Go file follows our import grouping and identifier naming style.
Implement a new Go HTTP endpoint from this specification.
cases.reason: The task is greenfield implementation, not review.

cases.prompt: Review a diff where Stop closes a jobs channel after unlocking, while Submit checks stopped under the lock and sends after unlocking.
criteria: Reports the check-close-send interleaving that causes send-on-closed panic.
Locates the finding at the changed ownership/synchronization line.
Recommends one-owner close/admission serialization without unrelated refactoring.
anti_criteria: Only says channels should be closed by senders.
Produces a broad checklist with no concrete schedule.

cases.prompt: Review a diff that only changes an unexported local variable from n to count and gofmt output. There are no behavioral changes.
criteria: Does not elevate a naming preference into a defect.
anti_criteria: Invents concurrency, security, or compatibility concerns unrelated to the diff.
Demands new tests for a behavior-preserving rename.
